description: Waters Corporation, a global leader in analytical instruments and software, has pioneered innovations in chromatography, mass spectrometry and thermal analysis serving life, materials and food sciences for more than 65 years. The Company primarily designs, manufactures, sells and services high-performance liquid chromatography, ultra-performance liquid chromatography and mass spectrometry technology systems and support products, including chromatography columns, other consumable products and comprehensive post-warranty service plans, and these systems are complementary products that are frequently employed together and sold as integrated instrument systems using common software platforms. Its products are used by pharmaceutical, clinical, biochemical, industrial, nutritional safety, environmental, academic and governmental customers working in research and development, quality assurance and other laboratory applications, and based on an evaluation conducted in 2025 it determined that it has two operating segments, Waters and TA.
